comments: The tool is read-only and evaluates a single page; it does not modify any content or code, and it is not an overlay. It is free with no signup or API key. The same engine is also reachable as a hosted MCP server at https://nexaaly.com/mcp for use from AI coding agents. We state on the tool itself that automated testing finds only a portion of WCAG issues and cannot determine compliance.
features: Opens one page in a real browser and reports accessibility problems, each with the code change that fixes it. Runs axe-core for WCAG 2.1 AA, plus additional checks a rules engine over the accessibility tree cannot perform: controls that look clickable but are not keyboard operable, error messages not linked to their field, and CAPTCHA barriers.
title: Nexaaly Accessibility Check
